# Brain capability map

*Generated by `tools/ship/takeCapabilityMap.mjs` from `brain/capabilityMap.mjs`; its gate (`brain/capabilityMap-selfcheck.mjs`) opens every cited file and changelog entry and checks that each quoted number is still there. Do not edit by hand.*

Which brain can do what at each simulation level, and what the record says about how well. A cell that no one read for this map says **EXISTS, UNREAD** and names the file; it does not guess a result.

## Legend

| status | meaning |
|---|---|
| TRAINED | a trained pilot is shipped or written, with a measured result |
| HAND-WIRED | the network is wired to reproduce the hand pilot; no gain is claimed |
| NO CHAMPION | searches ran and nothing qualified; no weights were written |
| TUNED | a hand rule whose numbers were fitted |
| SCRIPTED | a rule only |
| NO EFFECT | tried, and it did not help |
| NOT CONCLUDED | run, and the registered test could not decide |
| EXISTS, UNREAD | the files exist; this map did not read a result |
| - | nothing there |
| n/a | does not apply |

Brains: **Hand rule / PD autopilot**, **Fly circuit**, **GPU Brain (MLP)**, **Fish circuits**, **Language model**. An 'amoeba brain' does not exist in the tree.

15 tasks x 5 brains = 75 cells: 11 TRAINED, 1 HAND-WIRED, 2 NO CHAMPION, 4 TUNED, 1 SCRIPTED, 1 NO EFFECT, 1 NOT CONCLUDED, 11 EXISTS, UNREAD, 41 -, 2 n/a.

### Hold depth, heading and speed (a 6-DOF boat, no weapons)

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: TRAINED.** the PD cascade is the baseline every pilot is scored against (held-out -0.4880). Sources: brain/SUBMARINE_WIP.md ("-0.4880").
- **Fly circuit: TRAINED.** 963-weight pilot, seed 6002: held-out -0.3278 against the autopilot's -0.4880; later robust, tail, wide-hull and noisy-sense variants exist. Sources: brain/SUBMARINE_WIP.md ("0.3278"); brain/pilotSubWeightsRobustNoisyWip.json.
- **GPU Brain (MLP): -.** no sub pilot on the GPU Brain's MLP was found in brain/.
- **Fish circuits: TRAINED.** a fish circuit as a residual on the autopilot gains about 0.19 on pitch hold (4b-P) -- but shuffled wirings keep ~88% of it, permuted tuning 77-84%, memory adds nothing: the gain is the trained readout, not the fish. Sources: brain/FISH_VESTIBULAR_HELPER_WIP.md ("roughly 88 percent"); brain/FISH_VESTIBULAR_HELPER_WIP.md ("77 percent").
- **Language model: n/a.** a language model does not steer a hull.

### Find and sink a drone with sonar and torpedoes

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: TUNED.** the tactician is search/track/ping/attack/evade from sonar only, with 11 fitted numbers: 141 wins, 1 loss, 18 draws in 160 fresh duels against 117/11/32 for the hand numbers. Sources: brain/SUBMARINE_WIP.md ("141W 1L 18D").
- **Fly circuit: -.** no brain holds the tactician's seat; its 11 numbers were searched, not replaced.

### Survey run with a battery, a hull that feels pressure, a noisy gauge (needs and limits)

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: TUNED.** the rule advisor GUARDED-FILTER (surface under a charge threshold that falls with depth) beats every model and every fixed cap: mean 0.763/0.713/0.806 against the brain alone 0.586/0.558/0.638. Sources: brain/NEEDS_AND_LIMITS.md ("RULE-GF 0.763 | 0.713 | 0.806").
- **Fly circuit: NOT CONCLUDED.** the circuit pilot's registered task re-check could not pass under the noisy gauge (a defect of my registration, restated post hoc as Round 3 amendment 3). Sources: brain/NEEDS_AND_LIMITS.md ("AMENDMENT 3").
- **GPU Brain (MLP): -.** a trained advisor or pilot on the MLP is the experiment not yet run.
- **Language model: NO EFFECT.** gemma2:9b and llama3.1:8b at temperature 0, 4,273 and 4,217 situations on the reserved seeds: mixed against the brain alone, a tie with the best fixed cap, a loss to the rule on every audit. Sources: brain/NEEDS_AND_LIMITS.md ("NO CONSISTENT EFFECT (MIXED)").

### Heading through a compass dropout (rung 4a: circuits as estimators)

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: EXISTS, UNREAD.** a plain dead-reckoning navigator flies the dropout. Sources: render/subDropoutData.mjs.
- **Fly circuit: EXISTS, UNREAD.** the fly's heading-loop circuit as an estimator behind the autopilot (rung 4a versions 3-5 in the WIP); result not read for this map. Sources: brain/SUBMARINE_WIP.md ("RUNG 4a VERSION 3").
- **Fish circuits: EXISTS, UNREAD.** the best random wiring of the same size is the control; result not read for this map. Sources: brain/SUBMARINE_WIP.md ("RUNG 4a VERSION 4").

### Real fixed-wing flight: hold altitude, heading and airspeed through gusts and recoveries

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: TRAINED.** the PD autopilot (audit -0.4223). Sources: changelog v4869 ("-0.4223").
- **Fly circuit: TRAINED.** 243 of 1,099 weights moved: audit -0.3199 against -0.4223; the gain is in recoveries and gusts, almost none on calm starts; equally safe, not safer. Sources: changelog v4869 ("-0.3199").
- **GPU Brain (MLP): HAND-WIRED.** an 18-32-32-4 MLP wired to reproduce the autopilot to 5e-8; the GPU does not make a flight faster (the flight model is CPU arithmetic). Sources: changelog v4870 ("THE GPU DOES NOT MAKE A FLIGHT FASTER").

### Aircraft heading hold (es-aircraft)

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: EXISTS, UNREAD.** the PD heading-hold controller. Sources: brain/autopilotAircraft.mjs.
- **Fly circuit: TRAINED.** "the aircraft has a trained pilot" (v4843); its numbers were not read for this map. Sources: changelog v4843 ("the aircraft has a trained pilot").

### Helicopter and quadrotor: hover, land, engine-out landings

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: EXISTS, UNREAD.** hand pilots for the helicopter and the quadrotor. Sources: brain/autopilotRotor.mjs; brain/autopilotDrone.mjs.
- **Fly circuit: TRAINED.** the helicopter's fruit-fly pilot: audit -1.2188 against the hand pilot's -2.0770, 24 scenarios better and 10 worse, engine-out landings stand 8 s after contact in 18 of 20 flights against 5. Sources: changelog v4877 ("-1.2188").
- **GPU Brain (MLP): EXISTS, UNREAD.** a quadrotor MLP (1,860 weights) with V2 weights; result not read for this map. Sources: brain/pilotDroneMlp.mjs; brain/pilotDroneMlpWeightsV2.json.

### Jet dogfight (guns), league against the autopilot, itself and the other brain

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: EXISTS, UNREAD.** the jet's hand pilot (AUTOPILOT_JET_FIGHT). Sources: brain/autopilotFlight.mjs.
- **Fly circuit: NO CHAMPION.** a shipped fighter exists, but retraining in a league found no champion in 8 searches, then 4, then more; the fruit fly's gain on duels cost it the turning fights. Sources: brain/DOGFIGHT_LEAGUE_WIP.md ("NO CHAMPION").
- **GPU Brain (MLP): NO CHAMPION.** a shipped fighter exists; the league run's gain was small (58-93-49) and no search qualified. Sources: brain/DOGFIGHT_LEAGUE_WIP.md ("58-93-49").

### Bomber and capital ship against fighters (gunners in the seats)

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: EXISTS, UNREAD.** scenario files with gunner seats. Sources: brain/bomberFight.mjs; brain/battleshipFight.mjs.
- **GPU Brain (MLP): EXISTS, UNREAD.** two gunnery brains (v4206): a naval policy that scores every unknown cell and a turret gunner; result not read for this map. Sources: brain/navalPolicy.mjs; brain/gunnerPolicy.mjs.

### Endless-Sky style fleet battles (flight-gpu.html, es-box3d.html): who to shoot, when to break off

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: TUNED.** eight presets; the plainest ('scatter', the nearest target) wins 64% of the field; a FITTED eight-number vector beats the best preset 54-22 on the audit and takes 73.1% against the other seven. Sources: changelog v4849 ("54-22"); changelog v4849 ("73.1%").
- **Fly circuit: n/a.** these pages' tactics are eight numbers scored by a dot product, not the 34-neuron network (the pages say so). Sources: changelog v4843 ("NOT the 34-neuron fly-wired network").
- **GPU Brain (MLP): EXISTS, UNREAD.** the GPU Brain serves tactics weights once it has learned enough (GET /ai/brain/tactics); not read for this map. Sources: changelog v4843 ("the weights the GPU Brain serves once it has learned enough").

### Newtonian 6-DOF ship duel (es-box3d-6dof.html): turn, thrust, fire, and not ram

- **Hand rule / PD autopilot: EXISTS, UNREAD.** the PD attitude controller is the opponent and the baseline. Sources: brain/autopilot6dof.mjs.
- **Fly circuit: TRAINED.** a league-trained pilot (85 of 930 weights moved) -- but its 42-3 was one start's corridor; from a close joust start it lost all 80 games to the PD autopilot; a close-quarters pilot then beat the shipped one 106-12 and nothing learned to ram less; retrained at damage 6 at v4896; in the page's own fight (three a side, collisions on) the close-quarters pilot wins 730 of its 800 and is the only one better than the PD autopilot, which beats the League pilot 155-44. Sources: changelog v4846 ("85 of the 930 weights"); changelog v4848 ("loses all 80 games to the PD autopilot"); changelog v4848 ("106-12"); changelog v4896 ("retrained at damage 6"); brain/SIXDOF_PAGE_FIGHT_WIP.md ("W730/L58/D12"); brain/SIXDOF_PAGE_FIGHT_WIP.md ("W155/L44/D1").
- **GPU Brain (MLP): TRAINED.** the fly's Default recipe on the MLP, 29 of 1,637 weights kept: it beats its hand twin by the fly's rule (audit W10/L0/D10, where the twin draws all 20), but head to head with the fly's Default it won none of 80 (W0/L70/D10: fly better); a choice on the page's Load Pilots panel; in the page's own fight it ties the PD autopilot and loses to the fly's Default 76-123; a league round against the Default halved the duel gap (0-74 to 9-46 on fresh games) but did not qualify; a close-quarters round learned the joust against the Default (79-1 on fresh games, from 29-27) but not the standoff (0-66: it died in every standoff game), so it did not qualify either; nothing was written by either; twenty searches a brain by the first recipe could not tell the two networks apart (p = 0.265), and the fly's Default beat all 40 fresh searches of both: the 70-0 was the Default's draw. Sources: brain/SIXDOF_PAGE_FIGHT_WIP.md ("W123/L76/D1"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("p = 0.265"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("W1205/L24/D371"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("W9/L46/D25"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("W79/L1/D0"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("W0/L66/D14"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("died in all 80 standoff games"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("29 of the 1,637"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("W10/L0/D10"); brain/SIXDOF_GPU_BRAIN_WIP.md ("W0/L70/D10"); brain/pilot6dofMlpWeightsDefault.json; es-box3d-6dof.html ("pilot6dofMlpWeightsDefault.json").

## What the map says in one paragraph

Every shipped learned pilot is the fruit fly's circuit or the GPU Brain's MLP wired onto a hand controller and trained as a residual; where a gain is measured it is largest in recoveries, gusts and hard starts, small on the easy ones, and (for the fish circuits and the language models) not shown to come from the biology or the language. The hand rules and fitted numbers are the strongest components wherever they were compared head to head (the sub's survey advisor, the Endless-Sky tactics, the sub tactician). Weapons are used by: the sub tactician (torpedoes), the jet fighters and the 6-DOF space pilot (guns), the fleet tactics (eight fitted numbers) and the gunnery MLPs. No brain holds a seat in the sub duel, the space needs idea is unbuilt, and the jet leagues have no champion.
